- We can support the constraints you listed with the following operational controls:
  - Ephemeral sandbox: datasets will be mounted into an isolated sandbox project with role-based ACLs.

  - No fine-tune policy: we will apply a tenant-level policy that blocks checkpointing or exporting model weights generated from runs that use raw dataset files.
  - Watermarking: Redwood can add an invisible provenance token to outputs produced in the sandbox for auditing.

Ben and Lauren looped in to confirm run cadence and acceptance criteria details. We do recommend signing a short MAP (DocuSign) to make the timeline and constraints explicit; happy to own that doc and share a draft.

- Dec 8: Acceptance call to agree PASS and schedule full dataset exchange or to enumerate remediation items

Would you like Redwood to prepare the DocuSign today?

Hi Maya — draft MAP is uploaded to DocuSign (link below) and includes the clauses you requested. Quick summary of how Redwood will operationalize the constraints for acceptance and closure:

1) Access & scope
   - Dataset mounted in a tenant-isolated sandbox project (RBAC restricted to the evaluation run team).
   - No export of raw files permitted from the sandbox.

2) Retention & verified deletion
   - Automated lifecycle triggers destroy the dataset 30 days after the acceptance call timestamp.
   - Deletion is recorded in our immutable audit logs with a deletion event (ISO timestamp) and the S3 object removal identifiers. We will provide the audit log export as a CSV post-delete.

3) No fine-tuning / model persistence
   - A platform policy blocks checkpointing and model snapshots when job inputs include files labeled "BrightCart_raw_eval". Attempts will fail with an explicit platform error code (EVAL-403).

4) Output handling and telemetry
   - Any telemetry Redwood uses for benchmarking will be aggregated at the job-level and scrubbed of raw text snippets; per-row examples will never be exported.

5) Acceptance criteria (to close the MAP)
   - BrightCart returns PASS on at least 3 canonical prompts in the acceptance run with no data leakage issues reported.
   - Redwood provides ingest log and a short run-summary report.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/brightcart-eval-map
